research_notes: Blocked for the requested employment headlines: available dated roles are student/union/party or elected roles, all excluded by codebook. This does not establish zero other employment.

Checked official and party biographies, contemporary union inquiry material, ABC candidate history and targeted early-job/hospitality searches. No substantiated additional employer chronology emerged.
Any public/private total would require new evidence of non-excluded work with dates and full-time status; do not treat union representation of hospitality workers as hospitality employment.

Follow-up2026-10-02 overturns prior search gap: member’s2025 speech establishes previously omitted family-business assistance and casual bar employment during university. No calendar dates inferred from age14 years9 months. Whether the first formal job was the university bar role is not established; no extra duplicate role invented.

Targeted early-job/Hansard/own biography and employer-profile searches:2013 first speech and some2025 proceedings contain other members’ careers, which were not attributed to Chesters. Endometriosis ambassador image alt text belongs to another person and was ignored.

Next evidence: names/dates of family businesses and bar, nature of family remuneration, actual weekly hours, university dates/overlaps and dismissal date. Casual employment and union work do not become full-time public/private years. No gated-profile collection or outreach.
